Method of Attack: Phishing emails with malicious Excel macro attachments
Malicious macro code loads Task Scheduler Service and drops VBS script
Malware launches PowerShell and wscript.exe to obtain host details and send to C2 server
Use of spoofed domain to impersonate legitimate government website
Abuse of Mailman for phishing email distribution
Impacted Systems: Hotel systems in luxury hotels in Macao, China
Attack Vector: Phishing emails impersonating Macao Government Tourism Office
Indicators of Compromise: C2 IP address tracked by Trellix and previously reported by Zscaler
